params.name: page
params.description: Current page of the collection. Defaults to 1.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items returned. Verified live: values outside 1-100 return HTTP 400 rest_invalid_param.

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a string.

params.name: order
params.description: Order sort attribute ascending or descending.

params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines the fields present in the response. Only view and embed are available anonymously.

params.name: _fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to limit the response to. Verified live.

params.name: slug
params.description: Limit results to pages with one of the given slugs.

params.name: parent
params.description: Limit results to pages with the given parent page IDs.

params.name: menu_order
params.description: Limit results to pages with a specific menu_order value.

items.docs: Returns a paginated collection of published pages. Total item and page counts come back in the X-WP-Total and X-WP-TotalPages headers; RFC 8288 Link carries next/prev.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique numeric identifier for the object.

params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines the fields present in the response. Only view and embed are available anonymously.

params.name: _fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to limit the response to. Verified live.

items.docs: Returns a single published page by its numeric WordPress page ID.
